title: Bootstrapping Semantic Segmentation with Regional Contrast (ReCo)
mechanism: Supervised pixel-level contrastive loss on a sparse set of hard negative pixels with small memory footprint.
adaptation: Projection head on the full-res decoder stage (1/4 res would erase 1-2 px cracks); class-balanced anchor sampling with per-class caps; hard negatives for crack drawn from scuff, gridline and busbar pixels.
min_experiment: Arm: ReCo loss weight 0.1 on top of the best loss/sampling arm, 3 seeds; baseline that arm; metric crack relF1@2, mIoU_rob, E1 crack recall; kill if no metric gains >= 0.01.
evidence: R: consistent gains in supervised and semi-supervised seg; strongest with very few labels (5 examples per class).
prior_overlap: none: pixel contrast never tried (MIM/DDeP pretraining is a different objective).
